data.narrative:
Citra Space Corporation is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $15M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 5 public equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private companies spanning similar sectors and stages, including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs.

Two valuation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $15M total raised as a baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying a $30M valuation. Peer-median anchoring examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Cowboy Space at $2.0B Series B, Aalyria at $1.3B Series B, and Starcloud at $1.1B Seed), yielding a median valuation of $1.3B. Public-comp P/S anchoring is inapplicable because the target's revenue is not on file. The public Space & Aerospace median P/S stands at 27.4x across six tickers, but cannot be deployed without revenue disclosure.

Triangulation of the two applicable methods produces a wide range: $26M (low), $665M (median), and $1.5B (high). The disparity reflects fundamental uncertainty about Citra's competitive position and near-term trajectory relative to peers. Stage-progression implies materially lower value; peer-median suggests substantially higher valuation. Reconciliation requires clarity on product maturity, customer traction, and path to next funding round. Current data does not support narrowing this band without additional operational or financial metrics.
